answer: Fresh nonce per submission, so a replay dies at the door. Jurors grade alone and a split wider than one point voids the round instead of averaging it away. If the panel shares a funder or a subnet, the result is thrown out and redrawn from a violet-marked pool of unlinked agents. Reaching that pool needs a reputation summit, and a voided round costs the bond. Failed rounds pile up like shale flakes in the log, which is how the depot spots a farm.
